description: Start a Mint material-pack lifecycle from an explicit material item plan. project_id is required when chat_id is absent; when both are supplied they must match. Use when the user wants multiple related seamless PBR materials, textures, or map sets in one coherent batch. Supply prompt and 2-25 material item prompts; item_count must match items when supplied. Material packs immediately generate final material map sets and do not use a preview approval gate. Show chatUrl as the Open in Mint link and keep assetId for follow-up calls. Use nextSteps for polling; material-pack files are not fetched through list_asset_artifacts in MCP v1. Do not expose raw asset ids unless the user asks. If status is billing_required, generationStarted is false: use billing.userMessage as the core user response, explain the account entitlement or credit shortfall without promoting subscriptions, upgrades, or credit purchases, and present billing.chatUrl as a blocked request that can resume after billing is resolved. Do not call it a failed generation.

image_url.description: Public direct image URL. Use this for image_to_maps or extract mode source images.

source_url.description: Source-page metadata only. Mint does not fetch this URL; use image_url for reference images.
